title: Connecting with My World
sub: Buku pendamping Bahasa Inggris Kelas 7 SMP/MTs
intro:
📌 Capaian Pembelajaran Fase D (ringkas)
  • Menyimak–berbicara: berinteraksi dalam situasi sosial sehari-hari (perkenalan, rutinitas, sekolah, makanan, rumah).
  • Membaca–memirsa: memahami teks deskriptif dan prosedur sederhana, mengenali ide pokok dan informasi rinci.
  • Menulis–mempresentasikan: menulis teks pendek tentang diri, orang lain, tempat, dan cara membuat sesuatu.
cando: Memperkenalkan diri dan orang lain dengan to be dan possessive adjectives.
Mendeskripsikan orang dengan have/has dan kata sifat.
Menceritakan rutinitas dengan simple present tense dan adverbs of frequency.
Mendeskripsikan sekolah dengan there is/are dan prepositions of place.
Memesan makanan dan menulis procedure text sederhana.
Menceritakan kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung (present continuous).

text.pron_html:
🔊 Tanda pelafalan /.../
Pada beberapa kosakata disertakan bantuan pelafalan dalam ejaan Indonesia, misalnya schedule /ské-jul/. Huruf é dibaca seperti “e” pada bebek, dan e seperti pada emas. Gunakan sebagai bantuan saja — biasakan menyimak penutur asli melalui video, podcast, atau kamus daring yang menyediakan audio.

sections.title: A self-introduction
paras:
Hi, I'm Kirana!
Hello, everyone! My name is Kirana Putri. I am twelve years old, and I am a student at SMP Negeri 1 Malang. I am in class 7A.
I live with my family on Jalan Merdeka. My father is a farmer and my mother is a teacher. I have one younger brother. His name is Bayu, and he is eight years old.
My hobbies are reading comics and playing badminton. My favourite subject is English because it is fun. I want to be a doctor in the future.
Nice to meet you all!

sections.title: Descriptive text
paras:
My Best Friend, Raka
I have a best friend. His name is Raka. He is thirteen years old and he lives near my house, so we go to school together every day.
Raka is tall and slim. He has short black hair and brown eyes. He always wears glasses because he likes reading.
Raka is smart and diligent. He is also very helpful. When I have difficulties in Maths, he always helps me. Sometimes he is quiet, but he is funny with his friends.
I am happy to have a friend like Raka.

sections.html: Descriptive text menggambarkan orang, benda, atau tempat tertentu. Strukturnya: Identification (siapa/apa yang dideskripsikan) → Description (ciri fisik, sifat, kebiasaan). Teks ini memakai simple present tense.

A Day in Aldi's Life
Aldi is a student in class 7C. He always wakes up at half past four. After he prays Subuh, he takes a bath and has breakfast with his family.
He goes to school by bicycle at a quarter past six. School starts at seven o'clock. At school, he studies many subjects. His favourite is Science.
Aldi usually gets home at two. In the afternoon, he often plays football with his friends. He sometimes helps his mother in the kitchen.
In the evening, he does his homework. He rarely watches TV on school days. He goes to bed at nine.

sections.title: Descriptive text
paras:
Welcome to SMP Nusantara
SMP Nusantara is a junior high school in Bogor. It is not very big, but it is clean and green. There are eighteen classrooms on two floors.
In front of the school, there is a large field. We do the flag ceremony there every Monday. Behind the field, there is a mosque and a canteen.
There is a library on the second floor. It has more than three thousand books. Next to the library, there is a computer lab with thirty computers.
The students are friendly and the teachers are helpful. I love my school!

sections.title: Procedure text
paras:
How to Make Simple Fried Rice
Ingredients: a plate of cooked rice, an egg, two cloves of garlic, three shallots, a little salt, two spoons of sweet soy sauce, some oil.
Tools: a frying pan, a spatula, a knife, a plate.

Steps: First, chop the garlic and shallots. Next, heat some oil in the frying pan. Then, fry the garlic and shallots until they smell good. After that, add the egg and stir it. Put in the rice, the sweet soy sauce, and a little salt. Stir well for three minutes. Finally, serve the fried rice on a plate. Enjoy!

sections.html: Procedure text menjelaskan cara membuat atau melakukan sesuatu. Strukturnya: Goal (judul/tujuan) → Materials (bahan & alat) → Steps (langkah). Ciri bahasanya: kalimat perintah (imperative: chop, heat, stir) dan kata urutan (first, next, then, after that, finally).

Present continuous

sections.title: Read the text
paras:
Sunday Morning at My House
It is nine o'clock on Sunday morning. Everybody in my house is busy.

My father is in the garden. He is watering the plants. My mother is in the kitchen. She is cooking nasi uduk for breakfast. My little sister, Ayu, is sitting on the sofa in the living room. She is watching cartoons.

My grandfather usually reads the newspaper on the terrace, but today he is fixing my bicycle. And me? I am cleaning my bedroom. I clean it every Sunday. Our house is not big, but it is warm and comfortable.
